name: cc-testador-subagents
description: Browser-real QA gate for Claude Code. Sits between the Orchestrator and the Executor: ingests a build delivery, drives critical flows in a real browser via Playwright MCP, runs deterministic Playwright specs plus @axe-core/playwright, validates UI/UX against OpenSpec Scenarios and Open Design tokens, and hands a blocking/informative findings report back to the Executor. Read-only: never writes production code, never touches openspec/.

plugins.name: cc-testador-subagents
plugins.description: Testador skill + /testador slash command for real-browser QA. Ingests the Orchestrator's delivery (or a standalone target), runs a skills-aware preflight (Playwright MCP + webapp-testing + frontend-design + ui-ux-pro-max), builds a traceable coverage matrix from PRD/OpenSpec, explores via MCP, generates deterministic Playwright + axe specs, validates UI/UX against Open Design, triages findings by an explicit blocking rule, and hands a report to /executor.
